correctness.rationale: The equivalence between unavoidable sets and FVS in the finite constrained shift graph is proved. Disjoint admissible necklaces force c_k selected vertices; equality forces one per necklace. For k=2..8, the exact product of necklace lengths is exhaustively traversed, and every candidate is either certified cyclic or accepted acyclic. Independently implemented Kahn topological DP and DFS recursion yield byte-equivalent sorted optimizer catalogues and identical longest-path histograms. Complete source and exact list are embedded. No infinite-length claim.

originality.rationale: The original claim is the complete optimizer multiplicity and waiting-window spectrum in the shift with 11 forbidden, not the known minimum size or necklace table. The author-supplied full Champarnaud–Hansel–Perrin manuscript proves minimum size and lists cyclic orbit numbers, but contains no enumerations of all minimum restricted-language unavoidable sets or residual path histograms. Moreno studies golden-mean de Bruijn sequence counts, not minimum cycle-breakers. Published full-shift residual-path optimization results do not imply the constrained full census. Three semantic mathematical index searches found no equivalent or dominating statement; this cannot establish global uniqueness. Unindexed data or uninspected articles could overlap.
residual_risks: Earlier unindexed datasets or independent exact enumerations of constrained golden-mean feedback vertex sets may exist.
2024 minimum-decycling-set work and some related older conference/full paper editions were not all inspected in full; a plausible matching table would require renewed human comparison.
Independent external scientific validation is not performed.

value.rationale: An established SFT minimum-set theorem gives only existence and size; the complete structural enumeration and waiting-window spectrum reveal design differences at fixed optimal cardinality. For length eight the 240 minimum-size sets split into eight distinct sharp cutoff classes and exactly 16 provide length-23 hitting. This natural exact finite invariant is directly motivated by constrained symbolic dynamics and universal hitting sets and is not a routine reformulation of the known size.
